capabilities.description: Sync the vault, append text under a `## HH:MM` heading to today's daily note or a topic's note, commit it through the mount and push it.

inputSchema.description: Append text under a `## HH:MM` heading to today's daily note, or to a topic's note.

text.description: The Markdown to append; not only whitespace.
text.title: Text

topic.description: The title of the note to append to, at notes/<slug>.md; today's daily note when left out.
topic.title: Topic

vault.description: The vault mounted at /vaults/<vault>; the only one mounted there when left out.
vault.title: Vault

inputSchema.title: AddInput

capabilities.name: add

outputSchema.description:
Where the text went.

`path` is the logical path written and `commit` the vault's commit that
holds it, which the mount's pin names. `parked` is null, or the Board code
that kept the text out of the note: it went to the sibling `<name>.agent.md`
instead. `unpushed` is null when the commit reached the vault's remote, or
the Board code of the sync that did not push it.
outputSchema.title: AddOutput

capabilities.description: Sync the vault and print a day's daily note, unless the note is private.

inputSchema.description: The daily note of one day, as the vault's remote holds it.

date.description: The day, as YYYY-MM-DD; today, in this machine's time zone, when left out.
date.title: Date

vault.description: The vault mounted at /vaults/<vault>; the only one mounted there when left out.
vault.title: Vault

inputSchema.title: DailyInput

capabilities.name: daily

outputSchema.description:
The daily note.

`text` is null when the note does not exist, or when it is private:
its frontmatter has a `private` key whose value is not plainly false
(`false`, `no`, `off` or `0`), as Reflect keeps private notes from AI. A read
creates no note. `commit` is the vault's commit read. `unsynced` is null
when the vault synced first, or the Board code of the sync that failed,
and the note is then as this clone holds it.
outputSchema.title: DailyOutput

description: Append a note to today's daily note, or to a topic's note, in a Reflect vault mounted at /vaults/<name>, and read a day's daily note. Use it when the person asks you to note something down or asks what their daily note says. Start with `board -C <board> call notes.daily`, which syncs the vault and prints today's note. SKILL.md and README.md in the plugin's directory say more.
name: notes
